# Fireworks-Charlie: RLVR Training Pipeline v2.1
# Comprehensive Codebase Documentation for LLM Context
# Last Updated: 2025-11-01

================================================================================
PROJECT OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Fireworks-Charlie is a production-grade RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with
Verifiable Rewards) training pipeline for financial market prediction. It
collects multi-source financial data, generates investment theses using LLMs
(DeepSeek via Fireworks AI or direct API), tracks positions with verifiable
outcomes, calculates sophisticated multi-metric rewards, and produces JSONL
datasets for GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) fine-tuning.

**Core Innovation**: Point-in-time data integrity with hierarchical prompting,
provider-agnostic LLM integration, advanced multi-metric reward functions,
and comprehensive position tracking with early-exit logic.

**Key Architecture**: External APIs → Data Collection → PostgreSQL → Analysis
Engines → Prompt Building → LLM Generation → Position Tracking → Reward
Calculation → JSONL Datasets → GRPO Training

CORE DATABASE MODELS (database_manager.py:31-595)
================================================================================

Ticker (database_manager.py:31-56)
  Master ticker registry with metadata
  Fields: ticker_id (PK), symbol (unique), exchange, company_name, sector,
          industry, is_active, created_at, updated_at

MarketData (database_manager.py:58-96)
  Daily OHLCV + technical indicators (partitioned by date)
  Fields: market_data_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), date, open/high/low/close,
          volume, sma_20/50, ema_20, rsi_14, macd, macd_signal,
          bollinger_upper/lower

Fundamental (database_manager.py:98-156)
  Quarterly financial statements
  Fields: fundamental_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), report_date, filing_date,
          market_cap, pe/pb/ps_ratio, eps, revenue, net_income, ebitda,
          total_assets/liabilities, cash_and_equivalents, total_debt,
          operating/free_cash_flow, revenue_qoq/yoy_pct, *_json

News (database_manager.py:158-197)
  News articles with sentiment analysis
  Fields: news_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), published_at, headline, summary,
          content, url (unique), source, sentiment_score, sentiment_label,
          sentiment_confidence

MacroeconomicIndicator (database_manager.py:199-222)
  Economic indicators from FRED API
  Fields: macro_id (PK), series_id, indicator_name, country, date, value,
          unit, frequency

MacroFeature (database_manager.py:224-256)
  Derived macroeconomic features
  Fields: feature_id (PK), date, yield_curve_10y_2y/3m, cpi_monthly/yoy_pct,
          pce_monthly/yoy_pct, gdp_qoq_pct, industrial_production_mom_pct,
          unemployment_rate/change, fed_funds_rate

TickerEventFeature (database_manager.py:258-281)
  Time-since-event features
  Fields: event_feature_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), date,
          days_since_last_news, days_since_last_insider_trade

NewsSentimentFeature (database_manager.py:283-307)
  Rolling news sentiment aggregates
  Fields: sentiment_feature_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), date,
          sentiment_7day_avg/count, daily_article_count

InsiderTransaction (database_manager.py:309-340)
  Insider trading transactions
  Fields: transaction_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), transaction_date, filing_date,
          owner_name/title, transaction_code, shares, transaction_price,
          shares_owned_after

ThesisGeneration (database_manager.py:346-391)
  AI-generated investment theses with full prompts
  Fields: thesis_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), as_of_date, generated_at,
          system_prompt, user_prompt, assistant_response (JSONB),
          predicted_action, reasoning, support, model_name, temperature,
          tokens_used, generation_time_ms, status, error_message

Position (database_manager.py:393-439)
  3-day position tracking with performance
  Fields: position_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), thesis_id (FK), entry_date,
          entry_price, predicted_action, exit_date, exit_price,
          actual_return_pct, days_held, early_exit, early_exit_reason,
          directional_accuracy_score, met_threshold, status

RLVRTrainingExample (database_manager.py:441-481)
  Complete RLVR examples ready for JSONL export
  Fields: example_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), thesis_id (FK), position_id (FK),
          dataset_split, example_json (JSONB), ground_truth (JSONB),
          example_metadata (JSONB), directional_score, sharpe_score,
          combined_score, historical_returns (JSONB), historical_return_count

HistoricalReturn (database_manager.py:483-509)
  Historical returns for Sharpe calculation
  Fields: return_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), position_id (FK), entry_date,
          exit_date, return_pct, return_sequence

SharpeCalculation (database_manager.py:511-538)
  Cached Sharpe ratio calculations
  Fields: sharpe_id (PK), ticker_id (FK), as_of_date, lookback_periods,
          mean_return, std_dev, sharpe_ratio, sharpe_score,
          returns_used (JSONB)

DataCollectionRun (database_manager.py:544-567)
  Audit log for data collection runs
  Fields: run_id (PK), run_type, start_date, end_date, tickers (ARRAY),
          started_at, completed_at, status, records_collected, errors_count,

RLVRGenerationRun (database_manager.py:569-595)

ORCHESTRATION MODULE
================================================================================

FireworksCharliePipeline (main_pipeline.py:30-500+)
  Main pipeline orchestrator
  Methods:
  - __init__()
  - run(tickers, start_date, end_date, resume) → Dict[str, Any]
    Pipeline phases:
    1. Data Collection: Collect ticker + macro data + feature engineering
    2. Thesis Generation: For each ticker, for each trading day:
       - Get point-in-time data
       - Build hierarchical prompts
       - Generate thesis with LLM
       - Save to database
       - Create position tracking record
       - Checkpoint progress
  - _run_data_collection(tickers, start_date, end_date) → Dict
  - _process_ticker(ticker, trading_days, resume) → Dict
  - cleanup()

ConfigManager (config_manager.py:14-300+)
  Centralized configuration (singleton: config)
  Key Settings:
  - LLM Provider: LLM_PROVIDER ("deepseek" or "fireworks")
  - DeepSeek: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_MODEL, DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL
  - Fireworks: FIREWORKS_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID, MODEL_NAME
  - Database: DB_URL (PostgreSQL connection)
  - Model Config: MAX_TOKENS, TEMPERATURE (must be > 0 for GRPO)
  - GRPO: GRPO_NUM_RESPONSES, GRPO_EPOCHS, GRPO_LEARNING_RATE, GRPO_LORA_RANK
  - Generation: GEN_TEMPERATURE, GEN_TOP_P, GEN_TOP_K, GEN_MAX_TOKENS
  - Pipeline: START_DATE, END_DATE, TICKERS
  - Reward: DIRECTIONAL_ACCURACY_WEIGHT, SHARPE_RATIO_WEIGHT
  - RLVR: RLVR_MODE, RLVR_OUTPUT_DIR, EVALUATOR_ID, EVALUATOR_NAME
  Methods:
  - validate() → Dict[str, bool]
  - log_configuration(logger)
  - get_active_apis() → List[str]

  State persistence and recovery
  Methods:
  - save_checkpoint(ticker, data)
  - load_checkpoint(ticker) → Optional[Dict]

  - add_prompt_to_checkpoint(ticker, date, system_prompt, user_prompt, assistant_response)

Reward Function - Advanced (reward_function_advanced.py:1-500+)
  Sophisticated multi-metric evaluation system
  Exported: stock_prediction_reward(messages, original_messages, **kwargs) → EvaluateResult

  Evaluation Components:
  1. Directional Accuracy (40%) - Is direction correct?
  2. Magnitude Accuracy (25%) - How close is prediction to actual?
  3. Risk-Adjusted Performance (20%) - Sharpe ratio
  4. Confidence Calibration (10%) - Are strong signals more accurate?
  5. Downside Protection (5%) - Extra penalty for large losses

  Constants:
  - DIRECTIONAL_WEIGHT = 0.40
  - MAGNITUDE_WEIGHT = 0.25
  - SHARPE_WEIGHT = 0.20
  - CALIBRATION_WEIGHT = 0.10
  - DOWNSIDE_WEIGHT = 0.05

  Action Thresholds:
  - STRONG_BUY_THRESHOLD = 3.0%
  - BUY_THRESHOLD = 2.0%
  - HOLD_RANGE = (-2.0%, 2.0%)
  - SELL_THRESHOLD = -2.0%
  - STRONG_SELL_THRESHOLD = -3.0%

  Internal Functions:
  - _extract_assistant_response(messages) → Optional[str]
  - _validate_response_data(response_data) → bool
  - _evaluate_action_reasonableness(predicted_action, reasoning, support) → float
  - _is_directionally_correct(predicted_action, actual_return) → bool
  - _calculate_magnitude_accuracy(predicted_action, actual_return) → float
  - _calculate_sharpe_ratio(returns, risk_free_rate=0.0) → float
  - _normalize_sharpe_ratio(sharpe_ratio) → float
  - _calculate_confidence_calibration(predicted_action, actual_return, is_correct) → float
  - _calculate_downside_penalty(predicted_action, actual_return) → float

PositionTracker (position_tracker.py)
  3-day position tracking with early exit logic
  Methods:
  - __init__(db_session, hold_days=3, early_exit_enabled=True)
  - track_position(ticker_id, entry_date, entry_price, predicted_action) → Optional[Dict]

================================================================================
ENTRY POINTS
================================================================================

rlvr_main.py (Main RLVR CLI - 445 lines)
  Commands:
  - generate: Generate RLVR datasets from thesis generations
    Usage: rlvr_main.py generate --tickers AAPL,MSFT --start-date YYYY-MM-DD
           --end-date YYYY-MM-DD --train-split-date YYYY-MM-DD --output-dir DIR

  - test-local: Test reward function locally (with --sample flag)
    Usage: rlvr_main.py test-local --sample

  - deploy: Deploy reward function to Fireworks AI
    Usage: rlvr_main.py deploy

  - train: Submit GRPO training job to Fireworks AI
    Usage: rlvr_main.py train

  - validate: Validate RLVR setup (config, database, reward function)
    Usage: rlvr_main.py validate

  - stats: Show RLVR statistics (tickers, theses, positions, examples)
    Usage: rlvr_main.py stats

  - status: Check GRPO training job status
    Usage: rlvr_main.py status --job-id JOB_ID

main.py (Legacy Pipeline - 183 lines)
  Thesis generation pipeline entry point
  Usage: python main.py [--tickers AAPL,MSFT] [--start-date YYYY-MM-DD]
         [--end-date YYYY-MM-DD] [--no-resume] [--test]
         [--test-ticker TICKER] [--test-days DAYS]

generate_datasets_simple.py
  Simple dataset generation without full pipeline

================================================================================
SCRIPTS MODULE
================================================================================

scripts/deploy_reward_function.py
  Deploy reward function to Fireworks AI
  Function: deploy_reward_function() → bool
  Validates config, tests locally, deploys to Fireworks

scripts/train_grpo_model.py
  Submit GRPO training job to Fireworks AI
  Function: submit_training_job() → bool
  Uses Fireworks API to start fine-tuning job

scripts/evaluate_model.py
  Model evaluation utilities
  Function: evaluate_model(model_path, dataset_path) → Dict

scripts/check_model_status.py
  Training job status checker
  Function: check_status(job_id) → Dict

scripts/init_db.sh
  Database initialization
  Creates schema, indexes, and initial data

scripts/setup.sh
  Project setup
  Installs dependencies, creates directories

scripts/setup_database.sh
  Full database setup with schema and functions

scripts/reset_database.sh
  Reset database (DANGER)

scripts/run_pipeline.sh
  Run full pipeline wrapper

scripts/compare_all_strategies.sh
  Compare different reward strategies

scripts/test_reward_locally.sh
  Test reward function locally

scripts/test_reward_with_preview.sh
  Test reward with preview output

scripts/submit_grpo_manual.sh
  Manual GRPO submission wrapper

================================================================================
JSONL DATA FORMATS
================================================================================

Training Format (train.jsonl):
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a financial analyst..."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Complete data prompt..."}
    // NO assistant message - model generates during training
  ],
  "ground_truth": {
    "actual_return_pct": 2.5,
    "exit_date": "2024-01-05",
    "days_held": 3,
    "early_exit": false,
    "entry_price": 100.0,
    "exit_price": 102.5
  },
  "metadata": {
    "ticker": "AAPL",
    "entry_date": "2024-01-02",
    "historical_returns": [1.2, -0.5, 3.1, ...],
    "thesis_id": 12345,
    "position_id": "pos_1_2024-01-02"
  }
}

Dev Format (dev.jsonl):
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "..."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "..."},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "{\"reasoning\": \"...\", \"action\": \"buy\", \"support\": \"...\"}"}
  ],
  "ground_truth": {...},
  "metadata": {...}
}

│                    LLM PROVIDER (FACTORY PATTERN)                           │
├───────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ FireworksDeepSeekClient       │ DeepSeekClient                               │
│ • generate_thesis()           │ • generate_thesis()                          │

                            │
                            ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     THESIS STORAGE                                          │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ThesisGeneration Table:                                                     │
│ • system_prompt (TEXT) - Full system instructions                          │
│ • user_prompt (TEXT) - Complete data prompt                                │
│ • assistant_response (JSONB) - Parsed JSON response                        │
│ • predicted_action (VARCHAR) - buy/sell/hold/strong_buy/strong_sell         │
│ • reasoning (TEXT) - Extracted reasoning                                   │
│ • support (TEXT) - Supporting evidence                                     │
│ • model_name, temperature, tokens_used, generation_time_ms                 │
└─────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                  │
                       READ (for RLVR generation)
                                  │
                                  ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                POSITION CREATION & TRACKING                                 │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PositionCreator + PositionTracker (3-day hold + early exit)                 │
│ • create_position_after_thesis()                                            │
│ • track_position()                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ Logic:                                                                       │
│  1. Entry: entry_date + entry_price (regular close)                         │
│  2. Hold: 3 trading days OR early exit if signal changes                    │
│  3. Exit: exit_date + exit_price (regular close)                            │
│  4. Return: (exit_price - entry_price) / entry_price × 100                  │
│                                                                              │
│ Stored in Positions Table:                                                  │
│ • entry_date, entry_price, exit_date, exit_price                            │
│ • predicted_action, actual_return_pct, days_held, early_exit                │
└─────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                  │
                                  ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                PERFORMANCE CALCULATION                                      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PerformanceCalculator + Reward Function (Advanced Multi-Metric)             │
│                                                                              │
│ Reward Components (Advanced - reward_function_advanced.py):                 │
│  1. Directional Accuracy (40%) - Binary correctness                          │
│  2. Magnitude Accuracy (25%) - Distance from threshold                      │
│  3. Risk-Adjusted Performance (20%) - Sharpe ratio                          │
│  4. Confidence Calibration (10%) - Strong signals accuracy                  │
│  5. Downside Protection (5%) - Penalty for large losses                     │
│                                                                              │
│ Directional Accuracy (Binary: 0.0 or 1.0):                                  │
│   • strong_buy: return >= +3.0% → 1.0, else 0.0                             │
│   • buy:        return >= +2.0% → 1.0, else 0.0                             │
│   • hold:       -2.0% ≤ return ≤ +2.0% → 1.0, else 0.0                      │
│   • sell:       return <= -2.0% → 1.0, else 0.0                             │
│   • strong_sell:return <= -3.0% → 1.0, else 0.0                             │
│                                                                              │
│ Sharpe Score (Normalized to [0, 1]):                                        │
│   sharpe_ratio = mean(returns) / std(returns)                               │
│   sharpe_score = min(sharpe_ratio / 1.0, 1.0)                              │
└─────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                  │
                                  ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              RLVR DATASET GENERATION                                        │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ RLVRDatasetGenerator                                                        │
│ • generate_rlvr_datasets()                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ Process:                                                                     │
│  1. Query thesis_generations from database                                  │
│  2. For each thesis:                                                         │
│     a. Create position tracking record                                      │
│     b. Calculate position return (entry → 3-day exit)                       │
│     c. Get historical returns (last 30 periods)                             │
│     d. Calculate reward score (multi-metric)                                │
│     e. Create RLVR example with ground_truth & metadata                     │
│  3. Split chronologically: 80% train, 20% dev                               │
│  4. Write JSONL files: train.jsonl, dev.jsonl                               │
│                                                                              │
│ Output:                                                                      │
│ train.jsonl - Training examples (NO assistant message)                       │
│ dev.jsonl - Dev examples (WITH assistant message for evaluation)            │
└─────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                  │
                          UPLOAD TO FIREWORKS AI
                                  │
                                  ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                FIREWORKS AI GRPO TRAINING                                   │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Inputs:                                                                     │
│ • train.jsonl - Training examples (no assistant message)                   │
│ • dev.jsonl - Development examples (with assistant for eval)               │
│ • reward_function.py - Custom reward function (deployed evaluator)         │
│                                                                              │
│ GRPO Training (Group Relative Policy Optimization):                         │
│ 1. Generate n responses per prompt (n=4-8)                                  │
│ 2. Calculate reward for each response using reward_function                │
│ 3. Rank responses by reward (group-relative)                                │
│ 4. Update model to prefer higher-reward responses                          │
│ 5. Repeat for all training examples                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ Output:                                                                     │
│ • Fine-tuned model checkpoint                                               │
│ • Training metrics (reward trends, loss curves)                             │
│ • Dev set evaluation results                                                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

================================================================================
ARCHITECTURE PATTERNS IMPLEMENTED
================================================================================

1. Factory Pattern
   - LLM client creation (FireworksDeepSeekClient vs DeepSeekClient)
   - Dataset generation (training vs dev examples)

2. Strategy Pattern
   - Multiple LLM providers (Fireworks, DeepSeek direct)
   - Multiple reward calculation strategies

3. Decorator Pattern
   - Reward function decorator for Fireworks AI integration

4. Singleton Pattern
   - Configuration manager (config instance)

5. Repository Pattern
   - DatabaseManager for data access abstraction

6. Observer Pattern
   - Checkpoint manager for state persistence

7. Template Method
   - Pipeline orchestration with customizable phases

8. Dependency Injection
   - Sessions, configs, and clients injected into constructors

================================================================================
CODE STYLE GUIDE & STANDARDS
================================================================================

Python Standards:
• PEP 8 Compliance: 120-character line limit, 4-space indentation
• Type Hints: Comprehensive - all function params and returns annotated
• Docstrings: Google-style for all public methods and classes
• Imports: Absolute imports, grouped (stdlib → third-party → local)
• Naming Conventions:
  - snake_case: functions, variables, methods
  - PascalCase: classes
  - UPPER_CASE: constants
• Error Handling: Try-except with specific exceptions, appropriate logging
• Logging: Structured logging with context (ticker, date, etc.)

SQL Standards:
• Keywords: UPPERCASE (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, etc.)
• Identifiers: snake_case (table_names, column_names)
• Indexes: Descriptive names (idx_table_column, uq_table_unique_key)
• Constraints: Named constraints (fk_table_ref, ck_table_condition)

Database Design:
• 14 Primary Tables with proper relationships
• JSONB columns for flexible storage (assistant_response, example_json)
• Partitioned tables for performance (market_data by year)
• 60+ indexes for query optimization
• Foreign key constraints with CASCADE delete
• Unique constraints for data integrity
• TIMESTAMP columns with automatic updates

Project Structure:
• Clear separation of concerns (data, business logic, orchestration)
• Modular design with well-defined interfaces
• Hierarchical organization (data_collection/, thesis_generation/, etc.)
• Shared utilities (utils/)

================================================================================
CONFIGURATION & ENVIRONMENT
================================================================================

Environment Variables (.env):
• Database: DB_URL (Postgresql connection)
• Fireworks AI: FIREWORKS_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID, MODEL_NAME
• DeepSeek: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_MODEL, DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL
• Data Sources: EODHD_API_KEY, FRED_API_KEY, FINNHUB_API_KEY, FMP_API_KEY
• Pipeline: TICKERS, START_DATE, END_DATE
• LLM Config: MAX_TOKENS, TEMPERATURE (must be > 0 for GRPO)
• GRPO Training: GRPO_NUM_RESPONSES, GRPO_EPOCHS, GRPO_LEARNING_RATE
• Reward Weights: DIRECTIONAL_ACCURACY_WEIGHT, SHARPE_RATIO_WEIGHT
• RLVR: RLVR_OUTPUT_DIR, EVALUATOR_ID, EVALUATOR_NAME
• Logging: LOG_FILE, LOG_LEVEL

Critical Thresholds:
• STRONG_BUY_THRESHOLD = 3.0%
• BUY_THRESHOLD = 2.0%
• HOLD_RANGE = (-2.0%, 2.0%)
• SELL_THRESHOLD = -2.0%
• STRONG_SELL_THRESHOLD = -3.0%

Token Management:
• MAX_TOKENS: 128000 (Fireworks DeepSeek V3.1-Terminus)
• TOKEN_BUDGET: 120,000 (recommended max per prompt)
• TOKEN_WARNING_THRESHOLD: 100,000 (warning threshold)
• Hierarchical summarization: Recent (full) → Medium (summarized) → Historical (insights)

================================================================================
KEY ARCHITECTURAL PRINCIPLES
================================================================================

1. Point-in-Time Integrity
   - All data retrieved strictly "as of" analysis date
   - No lookahead bias - historical data only
   - Database functions ensure proper date filtering

2. Separation of Concerns
   - Data collection separate from business logic
   - Analysis engines isolated from storage
   - Clear boundaries between pipeline phases

3. Hierarchical Prompting
   - Smart token management with 3-tier data organization
   - Recent data: Full detail (0-7 days)
   - Medium data: Weekly summaries (8-30 days)
   - Historical data: Key insights (31+ days)

4. Provider-Agnostic LLM Integration
   - Factory pattern for client creation
   - Support for Fireworks AI and DeepSeek direct
   - Unified interface across providers

5. Comprehensive Position Tracking
   - 3-day hold period by default
   - Early exit on signal changes
   - Full performance metrics (return, days held, etc.)

6. Multi-Metric Reward System
   - Directional accuracy (40%)
   - Magnitude accuracy (25%)
   - Risk-adjusted returns via Sharpe ratio (20%)
   - Confidence calibration (10%)
   - Downside protection (5%)

7. Checkpoint-Based Recovery
   - Incremental progress saving
   - Resume capability for long-running pipelines
   - Automatic cleanup of old checkpoints

8. Production-Ready Database
   - Comprehensive schema with 14 tables
   - JSONB for flexible data storage
   - Partitioning for performance
   - 60+ indexes for optimization

================================================================================
COMMON WORKFLOWS
================================================================================

1. Initial Setup:
   pip install -e .
   cp .env.example .env  # Edit with API keys
   ./scripts/init_db.sh
   python rlvr_main.py validate

2. Data Collection & Thesis Generation:
   python main.py
   # Or with custom parameters:
   python -c "
   from orchestration.main_pipeline import FireworksCharliePipeline
   pipeline = FireworksCharliePipeline()
   result = pipeline.run(tickers=['AAPL', 'MSFT'], start_date='2024-01-01',
                        end_date='2024-01-31', resume=True)
   pipeline.cleanup()
   "

3. RLVR Dataset Generation:
   python rlvr_main.py generate --tickers AAPL,MSFT --start-date 2024-01-01
     --end-date 2024-01-31 --train-split-date 2024-01-25
     --output-dir storage/rlvr_datasets

4. Reward Function Testing:
   python rlvr_main.py test-local --sample
   python rlvr_main.py deploy

5. GRPO Training:
   python rlvr_main.py train
   python rlvr_main.py status

6. Statistics & Monitoring:
   python rlvr_main.py stats

================================================================================
VETERAN DEVELOPER INSIGHTS
================================================================================

Architecture Strengths:
✅ Point-in-time data integrity prevents lookahead bias
✅ Hierarchical prompting optimizes token usage (120K budget)
✅ Multi-metric reward system provides nuanced feedback
✅ 4 specialized analysis engines (technical, fundamental, news, macro)
✅ Production-grade database with partitioning and 60+ indexes
✅ Checkpoint recovery for long-running pipeline resilience
✅ Comprehensive type hints throughout codebase
✅ Clear module boundaries with well-defined interfaces
✅ Provider-agnostic LLM integration via factory pattern
✅ Structured logging with appropriate levels throughout

Potential Improvements:
🔧 Add caching layer (Redis) for frequently accessed data
🔧 Consider async I/O for API calls (currently ThreadPoolExecutor)
🔧 Implement streaming JSONL writing for memory efficiency
🔧 Add model registry for tracking multiple model versions
🔧 Implement A/B testing framework for reward functions
🔧 Add Prometheus metrics + Grafana for monitoring
🔧 Increase unit test coverage from current to 95%+
🔧 Implement rate limiting with exponential backoff for external APIs
🔧 Add Pydantic models for runtime data validation
🔧 Implement comprehensive config validation at startup

Code Quality Observations:
⭐ Excellent:
  - Consistent naming conventions across all modules
  - Comprehensive Google-style docstrings
  - Proper separation of concerns
  - Extensive type hints
  - Structured error handling and logging
  - Database schema with proper constraints
  - Checkpoint-based recovery mechanism

⚠️ Watch Out For:
  - Token budget can be exceeded with high-volatility stocks
  - Sharpe ratio sensitive to outliers in returns
  - Database session management in multithreaded context
  - API rate limits may cause delays
  - Large datasets may require memory optimization
  - Early exit logic needs careful testing

Maintenance Guidelines:
1. Weekly: VACUUM ANALYZE database
2. Monthly: Update dependencies, REINDEX database
3. Quarterly: API key rotation, security review
4. Daily: Log rotation (30-day retention)
5. Daily: Checkpoint cleanup (7-day retention)
6. Weekly: Performance monitoring review

Scaling Considerations:
• Horizontal: Automatically scales - 1 worker per ticker for parallel processing
• Database: Partition by ticker for massive datasets
• Distributed: Celery workers for distributed processing
• CDN: Cache FRED data and fundamentals
• Load Balancing: Multiple Fireworks AI endpoints
• Memory: Streaming data processing for large datasets
• Caching: Redis for computed features and metadata

Essential Commands:
  python rlvr_main.py validate    # Validate setup
  python rlvr_main.py generate    # Generate datasets
  python rlvr_main.py test-local --sample  # Test reward function
  python rlvr_main.py deploy      # Deploy reward function
  python rlvr_main.py train       # Submit training job
  python rlvr_main.py status      # Check training status
  python rlvr_main.py stats       # Show statistics

Key Files by Purpose:
• Entry Point: rlvr_main.py
• Pipeline: orchestration/main_pipeline.py
• LLM Client: thesis_generation/fireworks_client.py
